purpose: Measure remaining S-U attrition when pure revenue-tag changes are bridged for availability only, without calculating a value across the seam.
accessOrder: freeze this preregistration and implementation hashes
require exact aggregate agreement with both committed E4a artifacts
apply the identity-only bridge to aggregate class counts
render the report from that JSON artifact

scope.negativeControl: S-G in the same windows and arms

bridgeRule.seamRule: The bridge changes only availability membership. It receives aggregate counts, never company values, and performs no growth, acceleration, subtraction, ratio, or interpolation across two identifiers.

testStatistic.primary: remaining attrition count and rate after the identity-only bridge
secondary: S-G recovered count as negative control
testStatistic.effectiveN: first-event companies in each window and arm; quarterly rows are not independent observations

nullModel: A pure identifier bridge recovers zero companies and leaves attrition unchanged.
threshold: At least one recovered company descriptively rejects the zero-recovery null. This is not a significance threshold, gate, or method promotion.
requiredInvariants: every recomputed E4a aggregate used by D3 equals its committed E4a artifact exactly
recovered plus remaining attrition equals pre-bridge attrition
retained after bridge plus remaining attrition equals first-event companies
the output contains no company identifiers, names, individual values, signal values, daily observations, or post-2020 dates
explicitNonClaims: The bridge is not installed in the confirmatory method or product.
Recovered availability does not prove that cross-tag values are economically comparable.
No result changes the completed red confirmatory verdict.
The result does not identify companies or causes of real attrition.
